name: Dice_44001

facePoses.eulerOrder: Unity Quaternion.Euler: qY * qX * qZ; degrees

notes: Only the physical default ordinary six-sided dice Model is exported; prefab FX are omitted.
One physical mesh submesh with two renderer materials. shadow is an additional shadow pass, not another body texture.
At runtime DiceController resets the Dice_44001 root local position/rotation/scale to zero/identity/one before applying result correction rotation. Keep Model local transform.

Original playback: animate Dice1/2/3 parent local TRS from clip tracks, then multiply Quaternion.Euler(correctionEulers[authoredLandingFaces[die]-1][wantedPoint-1]), then Model local transform. The third die is hidden if no third result.

Original position and quaternion curves include times, values, and slopes. Translation uses cubic Hermite; quaternion curves use Unity normalized quaternion interpolation. No physics simulation or invented keyframes included.
facePoses are the serialized UI standstill mapping; full throw playback must instead use correctionEulers for its authored landing face.
Two original throw variants are exported (one vertical, one horizontal), each containing all three authored die tracks. All other normal variant names remain in controller lists for provenance.
